text: Non-structural elements and equipment: seismic forces on equipment, piping supports, cable trays, cladding and suspended items shall be calculated per TBDY 2018 chapter 6 with the floor acceleration amplification, Rp and ap factors given there and the importance factor I = 1.5 for critical equipment. Equipment anchorage shall be verified for the DD-2 forces with overstrength; vendors shall supply anchor bolt loads for the seismic case and confirm seismic qualification of their equipment (analysis or test) for 0.45 g at the foundation level.
